CORE/ACCORDION-PANEL The content of an accordion section, hidden until its heading is clicked; second child of core/accordion-item, after core/accordion-heading. Full guide: see core/accordion. MARKUP

Panel text.

Any blocks go inside (paragraphs, lists, images, buttons). Keep role="region" before class. Whether it starts open is set on the item (openByDefault), not here.
